name: Scientific
victoryScreenHeader: Build the Titan Ascension Project and assemble the Titan vessel to win!
victoryString: The Titan vessel rises on a column of arcane fire, and Azeroth watches in silence. Your artificers and magi have unlocked what the makers left behind, and your people sail beyond the Great Dark to stand among the stars. The bards will need new songs; the old ones are too small.
defeatString: Another people's vessel has climbed into the sky, carrying the secrets of the Titans with it. Your workshops fall quiet and your scholars burn their notes. Yet the stars are patient, and so are your people. One day they will build again, and follow.

name: Cultural
victoryScreenHeader: Complete 5 policy branches and restore the Well of Eternity to win!
victoryString: The Well of Eternity shines again, and its light carries your name to every corner of Azeroth. Your poets, priests and loremasters have done what no army could: the world now sings your songs, keeps your holy days and tells your histories as its own.
defeatString: The Well of Eternity has been restored, but not by your hand. Your songs are fading from the taverns and your libraries gather dust. Still, a story is never truly lost while one keeper remembers it. Your people will tell it again.

name: Domination
victoryScreenHeader: Capture all enemy Capitals to win!
victoryString: The banners of every rival capital lie torn at your feet. From the frozen wastes of Northrend to the sands of Tanaris, one power rules Azeroth, and it is yours. Let the war drums fall silent. There is no one left to answer them.
defeatString: Your capital has fallen and your banners burn. Your armies are scattered across Azeroth, and the conquerors write the histories now. But in hidden valleys and forgotten caves, your people sharpen their blades and wait for the day of reckoning.

name: Diplomatic
victoryScreenHeader: Build the Grand Council of Azeroth and be voted its leader to win!
milestones: Anyone should build [Grand Council of Azeroth]
victoryString: The Grand Council of Azeroth has spoken, and every banner in the hall dips toward yours. Alliance, Horde and all who stand between have chosen you to lead them. You have won the world without a single siege, and your enemies are left wondering when they lost.
defeatString: The Grand Council of Azeroth has chosen another to lead. Your envoys return home with empty hands and bitter words. But councils change their minds, and alliances are never made of stone. Your people will be heard again.

name: Time
milestones: Have highest score after max turns
victoryString: The ages have turned, and when the sands of time settle, your people stand tallest. No dragonflight, no prophet and no conqueror can deny it: this era of Azeroth belongs to you.
defeatString: The ages have turned, and the chronicles of Azeroth name another people as the greatest of this era. Your people endure, and the Timeways are long. Their hour will come.
